messages:
Maria Gomez: filing this thread after ticket #3489 — customer reports being charged for both a partial stream and a resumed stream when their client retried.
Priya Nair: do we have HTTP logs and router traces? was the retry to the same route?
Maria Gomez: router shows initial stream -> region-phi, EOF after 2 tokens; client retried a new connection and CDN sent it to region-nyc. both sides logged provisional token grants.
Samir Chen: yeah that's the expected behavior today: provisional credits are local and committed on segment confirm. without a shared session id we can't tell they're the same session.
Ashok Patel: can we conservatively mark provisional credits as "postponed/mergeable" when we see a matching client IP + customer id + prompt hash within a short window?
Ben (billing): risky. IPs are shared and prompt hash collisions possible. finance will push back on underbilling. any merge must be conservative and require a higher-entropy correlate when possible.
Liz (console): support asked for clearer presentation. they saw two separate ledger rows in the UI and assumed two calls. can we highlight provisional rows and surface route metadata?
Maria Gomez: short-term fix: add a route_id column and a provisional badge in ledger UI. that will help support identify likely duplicates.
Priya Nair: telemetry request: emit stream.session.start, stream.segment.grant, stream.segment.finalize with session_client_id if present and router_route_id. that will help offline reconcile.
Samir Chen: agree. also propose adding stream.client_session_id header support in public API and document it in SDKs. make it optional but recommended for streaming.
Ashok Patel: if client doesn't supply it, server-side generated session id won't persist across retry via CDN, so it won't solve cross-region retries.
Ben (billing): long-term: billing pipeline can run a reconciliation pass that groups provisional charges by (customer_id + session_id) when session_id exists, else by a high-confidence fingerprint: prompt_prefix(12) + first_confirmed_token + time_window(45s). any grouping that isn't high-confidence should be marked "suspicious" not auto-merged.
Maria Gomez: customer in #3489 is asking for refund. ops: should we escalate manual review with those heuristics?
Liz (console): I'll add a filter in ledger UI to show "suspicious provisional duplicates" using the same heuristics so support can triage faster. ETA 2 business days for a quick filter.
Samir Chen: RFC for billing dedupe: I'll draft with safe heuristics and audit trail. include a safeguard: never merge entries that include toolcall.invocations unless tool reports idempotency token.
Ashok Patel: note: toolcalls are a separate failure mode — de-duping tokens is fine only if it doesn't mask external actions. add a rule to require toolcall_idempotency header or skip merge.
Priya Nair: small router change: include route_id in provisional-charge telemetry and log correlation_id if present. low-risk.
ops-bot: reminder: weekly oncall sync in 3h — add reconciliation RFC review to agenda.
Ben (billing): also need legal signoff on any auto-refund/dedupe logic. I'll flag with finance/legal now.
Maria Gomez: I'll respond to customer with interim explanation: showing provisional credits can appear on different routes on the ledger and we are investigating reconcile options.
Liz (console): putting a mock in Figma and will open a PR for the provisional badge + route column once design is reviewed: https://figma.redwood/ledger-mock
Samir Chen: ETA for RFC draft EOW, telemetry patches next sprint.
Maria Gomez: assigning ticket to eng-platform + billing for now, leaving thread open until we have RFC + console change merged.
